purpose: DESIGN A1 discriminating check. The r = 8 rung of the 64-interval smoke, refitted with the ridge FORCED to 1e-4 instead of the 0.0 that the ORIGINAL random-snapshot-COLUMN holdout selected. Run before the split was changed, so it measures the leak rather than arguing about it.
reading: With gamma = 0 the r = 8 quadratic arm did NOT converge (520 LM iterations, step stationarity 8.7e-4), scored 83.27 % worst evolved against its own linear control's 66.38 %, and cost 143.0 ms against 14.7 ms. With gamma = 1e-4 the identical arm converges in at most 12 iterations, scores 64.92 % -- better than its linear control AND than POD-8 (66.61 %) -- and costs 21.7 ms. The selection rule, not the method, produced the failure.
